title: Disaster recovery: RPO, RTO and DR strategies

kcs.statement: RPO is the maximum acceptable data loss measured in time (how old the last good copy may be); RTO is the maximum acceptable time to restore service after a disaster.

Disaster recovery strategies trade cost for recovery speed: backup and restore (cheapest, RTO of hours), cold site, warm standby, and hot site or multi-region active-active (most expensive, RTO of seconds to minutes).
Nightly backups give an RPO of up to 24 hours, continuous asynchronous replication to another region shrinks RPO to the replication lag, and synchronous replication brings it near zero.
